FULL-WOG VERTICAL WALL — bd-01M17JM6FM8RGWM38DP97611PT

Tree: git archive of 3468dce (27 top-level dirs, build.sbt present). Gate in that export, not the shared checkout. fixturesJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.fixtures.wog.NarrativeCompilerVerticalSuite; GATE_EXIT=0; Passed: Total 2. The landed one-sentence court still passes. The walk was a measurement added only in the export; the reserved suite on main was not edited.

Method: SurfaceAnalyzer.analyze on the public-domain WOG source (50 sentences). Same DeterministicFixtureProvider as the landed vertical. No new lexical rules. No DiscourseTrajectory.derive.

FIRST WALL

atlas.sentences(0) id=story:e4b036101a7a:s0
text: There were people at Egulac.
error: invalid fixture-provider 'There were people at Egulac.': no deterministic predicate rule

The landed provider matches only the substring "became" → lemma "become". Walking the whole source, that is the first stop. It is not a compiler stop.

Counts on this atlas: PROVIDER_OK=4 PROVIDER_FAIL=46.

The four sentences the existing rule emits:
  i=3  It became foggy and calm.
  i=42 He told it all, and then he became quiet.
  i=43 It was nearly daylight when he became quiet.
  i=46 His face became contorted.

WHAT HAPPENS IF THOSE FOUR ARE COMPILED AGAINST THE FULL ATLAS

This is not a repair and not a claim that 4/50 is a full-text model. It is the only multi-situation input the landed provider can produce without inventing rules.

NarrativeCompilerInput.of accepted the four charts / situations / contexts / memberships (summary taken from the first success, same artifact the provider already emits). NarrativeCompiler.compile returned Right.

  validated=false
  partial=true
  situations=4
  trajectory empty
  RecallSignature not reached

Three DiscourseTrajectory gaps, all UnsupportedTrajectoryInputs(ParticipantRole, TemporalRelation):

  trajectory:s3#…260c33301e2e -> s42#…f439bc7154a0
  trajectory:s42#…f439bc7154a0 -> s43#…0cee7a9c498f
  trajectory:s43#…0cee7a9c498f -> s46#…c40821348c60

Validation report, verbatim:

[Error] compiler.required-derivation @ trajectory:story:e4b036101a7a:s3#wog-fixture-concept:260c33301e2e->story:e4b036101a7a:s42#wog-fixture-concept:f439bc7154a0: trajectory-inputs-unsupported:ParticipantRole,TemporalRelation
[Error] compiler.required-derivation @ trajectory:story:e4b036101a7a:s42#wog-fixture-concept:f439bc7154a0->story:e4b036101a7a:s43#wog-fixture-concept:0cee7a9c498f: trajectory-inputs-unsupported:ParticipantRole,TemporalRelation
[Error] compiler.required-derivation @ trajectory:story:e4b036101a7a:s43#wog-fixture-concept:0cee7a9c498f->story:e4b036101a7a:s46#wog-fixture-concept:c40821348c60: trajectory-inputs-unsupported:ParticipantRole,TemporalRelation
[Error] hierarchy.member-within-parent @ containment/1: member span [1901, 1942) escapes parent span [99, 124)
[Error] hierarchy.member-within-parent @ containment/2: member span [1943, 1987) escapes parent span [99, 124)
[Error] hierarchy.member-within-parent @ containment/3: member span [2091, 2117) escapes parent span [99, 124)
[Error] trajectory.complete @ trajectory: 0 steps do not match the 3 adjacent discourse pairs

[99, 124) is sentence 3. The later three "became" sentences sit at those escaped member spans.

WHAT THIS IS

Mechanical reachability over the full source, not WOG narrative coverage. The first stop is the fixture provider on sentence 0. The expected promotion block is also live on the only multi-situation bag the landed provider can emit, and the validator prints a hierarchy containment error beside it. Derive was not used.
